# Sprunki

> > Sprunki is a free online music creation and rhythm game platform featuring dozens of mods, phases, and character-based beat-mixing gameplay.

Sprunki is a browser-based music game where players create beats by mixing sounds with quirky characters. The platform features multiple official phases (3-9) and community-created mods with varying themes from spooky horror to romantic, all playable online for free.

## Official Sprunki Phases

- [Sprunki Phase 3](https://sprunki.com/phase-3): Craft eerie, experimental beats with dark melodies and spooky gameplay.
- [Sprunki Phase 4](https://sprunki.com/sprunki-phase-4): Mix haunted beats with chilling vibes and remix gameplay.
- [Sprunki Phase 5](https://sprunki.com/sprunki-phase-5): Innovative music creation game with quirky characters and sound elements.
- [Sprunki Phase 7](https://sprunki.com/sprunki-phase-7): Latest horror-themed music mixing mod with unique characters and haunting visuals.

## Sprunki Mod Variants

- [Sprunki Retake](https://sprunki.com/sprunki-retake): Expressive hand animations and engaging music mixing gameplay.
- [Sprunki Mustard](https://sprunki.com/sprunki-mustard): Innovative music creation with diverse sound elements and quirky characters.
- [Sprunky](https://sprunki.com/sprunky): Mix sounds, explore styles, and remix through vibrant themes.
- [Sprunki Kiss Edition](https://sprunki.com/sprunki-kiss): Romantic mod blending heartwarming visuals with fun music gameplay.
- [Sprunki Grown Up](https://sprunki.com/sprunki-grown-up): Remix with human characters, offering endless beats and creative styles.

## Horror & Dark Themed Mods

- [Corruptbox 3 x Sprunki](https://sprunki.com/corruptbox3-x-sprunki): Horror music game with battle rhythm system and glitch effects.
- [Sprunki Anti Shifted Phase 5](https://sprunki.com/sprunki-anti-shifted-phase-5): Master industrial beats and uncover tragic lore.
- [Sprunki Phase 5: The Blackened Killer](https://sprunki.com/sprunki-phase-5-the-blackened-killer): Mix haunting beats and trigger scary animations.
- [Sprunki Switch](https://sprunki.com/sprunki-switch): Horror expansion with creepy animations and distorted cursed beats.
- [Sprunki Phase 9 Malediction](https://sprunki.com/sprunki-phase-9-malediction): Create unsettling tracks with mutated characters and cursed beats.

## Specialized & Remix Mods

- [Sprunki 5-Shifted Niki's Take](https://sprunki.com/sprunki-5-shifted-nikis-take): Craft evolving soundscapes with unique tonal phases.
- [Sprunki Anti-Shifted Phase 5 (Mr. A's Take)](https://sprunki.com/sprunki-anti-shifted-phase-5-mr-as-take): Refine beats with high-fidelity clarity.
- [Sprunki Crazy's Realm Remake](https://sprunki.com/sprunki-crazys-realm-remake): Revitalized mod with polished instability and explosive sounds.
- [Sprunki Anti-Shifted Phase 4](https://sprunki.com/sprunki-anti-shifted-phase-4): Create raw music with high-fidelity sounds and unshifted rhythms.
